notes: Two-stage food pipeline: GGCD YOLOv8n INT8 for 241-class food detection, EfficientNet-Lite0 INT8 for 905-class food classification. Classifier trained on 14-dataset merge spanning 10+ cuisine regions. All detection classes are food-specific (no COCO filtering needed). NMS is performed in JavaScript, not baked into models.

models.name: GGCD YOLOv8n (241-Class Food Detection)
models.description: YOLOv8n trained on Global Gastronomic Culinary Dataset. 241 food-specific classes spanning Central Asian, South Asian, East Asian, Middle Eastern, European, and American cuisines. INT8 quantized for mobile. NMS performed in JavaScript.

models.name: EfficientNet-Lite0 (905-Class Global Food Classifier)
models.description: Custom-trained EfficientNet-Lite0 on 14-dataset merge (Food-101, UEC-256, CNFOOD-241, Khana, THFOOD-50, MAFood-121, Taiwanese Food 101, VietFood67, 30VNFoods, Indonesian Food, Indian Foods, Ethiopian Foods, Central Asian Food, Padang Cuisine). 905 food-specific classes spanning 10+ cuisine regions. INT8 quantized. 76.72% top-1 validation accuracy.
